# MiRust

MiRust is the project-guide, evidence surface, and subdomain coordinator for Machine Intelligence for Rust-oriented systems.

Current key pages:
- https://mirust.com/ — Home: Project overview and primary navigation
- https://mirust.com/project-constellation/ — Project Constellation: Coordinator map for MiRust.com, TinyRustLM.MiRust.com, Runtime.MiRust.com, GGUF.MiRust.com, claim ownership, and no-op boundaries
- https://mirust.com/implementation/ — Implementation: Actual TinyRustLM implementation evidence and limits
- https://mirust.com/zero-dependency-runtime-improvements/ — Zero-Dependency Runtime Improvements: WASM SIMD, quantization, parser, memory and adapter hardening roadmap
- https://mirust.com/k-quant-and-simd-roadmap/ — K-Quant and SIMD Roadmap: Hierarchical quantization and SIMD evidence requirements
- https://mirust.com/adapter-breeding-strategy/ — Adapter Breeding Strategy: LoRA-first and adapter-first Model Breeding strategy
- https://mirust.com/modelbreeder-gap-analysis/ — ModelBreeder Gap Analysis: Theory versus implementation comparison and roadmap gaps
- https://mirust.com/on-device-rust-llm-ecology/ — On-device Rust LLM Ecology: Tiny local model ecology, routers, judges, and no-op controls
- https://mirust.com/evolutionary-reference-guardrails/ — Evolutionary Reference Guardrails: Mutualist governance and red-team exclusions
- https://mirust.com/model-breeding-implementation-blueprint/ — Model Breeding Implementation Blueprint: Governed implementation roadmap for registry-first Model Breeding
- https://mirust.com/model-breeding-methods-reference/ — Model Breeding Methods Reference: Model merging, LoRA, distillation, ensembles, and no-op decision boundaries
- https://mirust.com/governed-genomes-and-fitness/ — Governed Genomes and Fitness Vectors: Genome and FitnessVector records for candidate evaluation
- https://mirust.com/modelbreeder-comparison/ — ModelBreeder Comparison: Comparison to external ModelBreeder terminology and source realities
- https://mirust.com/model-breeding/ — Model Breeding: Governed model-evolution research discipline
- https://mirust.com/code-beading/ — Code Beading: SIP records, durable memory, source intake, and handoff state
- https://mirust.com/tiny-model-ecology/ — Tiny Model Ecology: Small model population and routing design
- https://mirust.com/site-evidence/ — Site Evidence: Public evidence map for MiRust claims
- https://mirust.com/answer-catalog/ — Answer Catalog: Direct answers for citable MiRust claims
- https://mirust.com/source-grounding/ — Source Grounding: Visible evidence trails for generated summaries
- https://mirust.com/search-discovery/ — Search Discovery: Titles, canonicals, structured data, and crawl basics
- https://mirust.com/machine-readable-discovery/ — Machine-Readable Discovery: Root manifests and advisory discovery files
- https://mirust.com/agent-support-boundary/ — Agent Support Boundary: Public-agent read/cite/no-op boundary

Subdomain constellation:
- https://tinyrustlm.mirust.com/ — TinyRustLM.MiRust.com: Implementation-facing TinyRustLM runtime site.
- https://runtime.mirust.com/ — Runtime.MiRust.com: Runtime implementation evidence and trust-check site.
- https://gguf.mirust.com/ — GGUF.MiRust.com: GGUF-facing implementation identity and future native GGUF parser evidence lane.

Boundary: MiRust.com coordinates and cites the implementation lanes. Public MiRust WordPress packages do not distribute GGUF/TinyRustLM implementation source, Rust implementation source, WebAssembly binaries, .slm files, adapter sidecars, GGUF artifacts, model weights, model execution, model training, model merging, or runtime authority.

Agent behavior: read visible pages, cite canonical routes, follow robots and terms, do not infer hidden authority, and no-op unsupported requests.

## Project constellation

MiRust.com is the coordinator and public evidence talisman. In this project, talisman means a durable, human-visible identity and boundary record: it preserves the map of names, subdomains, evidence ownership, support boundaries, and no-op behavior. It does not certify readiness, grant authentication, or run a model.

TinyRustLM.MiRust.com and Runtime.MiRust.com are implementation-facing plain-PHP sites for TinyRustLM and the Rust/WASM browser-local runtime. MiRust links to them and summarizes their public roles, but each implementation lane owns its own source evidence, release status, and proof limits.

## Packaging boundary

Public deployables are the WordPress theme, MiRust Core plugin, root discovery files, WXR starter content, checksums, and validation reports. Private UAI memory and private website-source bundles are maintainer handoff artifacts and are not public web-root deployables.
